name: National Assembly of Tanzania (Bunge)
notes: Elected constituency members, 115 women's special seats shared between parties by their vote, 5 from the Zanzibar House of Representatives, the Attorney General ex officio and up to 10 presidential nominees. No Seats chart: the Bunge site gave no member list that could be read, and press and encyclopedia totals disagree (396, 403 and 'CCM 398'); party counts for the special seats were not found. The total is left blank until the Bunge publishes it. No supporter sits.
